connect.plans.note: Uses a plan you already pay for.
connect.perUse.note: Charged each time you use it. Used only when you pick it.
connect.local.note: Runs on this computer. Used only when you pick it.
connect.server.note: A server you run. You say how it is paid for. Used only when you pick it.
connect.cloud.note: Charged to your cloud account. Used only when you pick it.
connect.other.note: How these are paid for is set by each company. Used only when you pick one.
connect.services.note: Services other than chat. Used only when you pick one.
billing.api: Charged per use to your {company} account
via.paste: Sign in, then paste the code back
via.setup_token: Paste a setup code from your plan
via.cli: Sign in inside its own app
via.plan_key: Paste the key from your plan
via.local: Use a model on this computer
ready.needs_binary: Install its app on this computer first.
ready.needs_host: Needs the app on your computer.
ready.needs_client: Not set up for this app yet.
ready.no_upstream_flow: This way to sign in is not available yet.
key.entry: Paste your key. It stays on this device.
key.ok: Your key is ready. It is used only when you choose this option.
key.invalid: This key could not be saved. Check it and try again.
